claims.fact: GTA 6 Wanted Level explained (Image credit: Rockstar Games) The GTA 6 Wanted Level meter has been increased to six stars, allowing for great nuances between the different measures of threat from the cops, so don't expect them to come after you guns blazing as soon as you get your initial star.
